we've seen assets like HYPE and ZEC perform independently of BTC and ETH, even during periods when the broader market was struggling

that makes identifying mispriced assets and understanding which teams are building increasingly important, rather than relying entirely on the direction of the majors

Sadly, however, most well-intentioned protests quickly devolve into violence by opportunists and in some instances are pushed further by state actors within the groups themselves

This results in a backlash against the protests from the majority of the population, a continuation of the status quo and further divisions amongst groups of people as a result of the damage. In the age of social media, this is more powerful than ever and can be weaponised incredibly well to play on people's sensibilities, keep them placated and accepting of the status quo, no matter how desperate their personal situation is becoming

Clearly this looks like a fucking warzone and people in these images are likely criminals, but why should anyone be surprised when those at the top have been systematically and ruthlessly looting and pillaging from the people for the last few decades

Yes fuck these images. But fuck the things that got us to them in the first place.
